titre: Le parc de compteurs d'eau bascule vers l'intelligent
sous_titre: millions de points de comptage installés en Europe et en Amérique du Nord, 2025 et 2031

Parc communicant 2025.texte: forecast to rise from 190.1 million units in 2025 to 249.2 million units in 2031

Parc communicant 2031.texte: forecast to rise from 190.1 million units in 2025 to 249.2 million units in 2031

Dont intelligents 2025.texte: Europe and North America had a combined 79.1 million water AMI endpoints installed at the end of 2025.

Dont intelligents 2031.texte: expects that figure to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 11.8 percent, reaching 154.5 million endpoints in 2031
